decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper builds directly on the firm's established dumper know-how and still has its own page, so the firm can readily interpret its results and keep refining it.
The articulated construction dumper sits within the firm's core construction vehicle competence and is still prominently presented, so absorptive capacity supports continuing it.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the established offer and was downgraded to a mere mention in 2024, which signals weaker fit, but the firm's underground engineering experience and its niche specialist market make retaining it somewhat more likely than dropping it.
The compact telescopic loader leverages the firm's lifting and loader expertise and keeps a dedicated page, so the firm is well placed to learn from it and improve it.
The material lift is close to the firm's core offer and is reported as the most popular rental lift with a recent large order, so it clearly continues.

Although the compact mining loader is further from the established offer, it builds on the firm's underground loader experience and shows quantified field success of 1,000 operating hours in 7 months, which gives the firm learnable evidence to justify keeping it.
